technical.summary: Bullish structure with golden cross and new highs, but overbought conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry probability despite strong moving average alignment.

fundamental.summary: AMP shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 89 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from small-amount sales by junior representatives, offset by neutral market sentiment and absence of recent news data; no actionable conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (186) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 89 days poses no immediate binary risk but compounds unfavourable backdrop.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + DC20 new high provide classic bullish structure with price near support (320.91), offering defined risk entry for mean reversion in oversold macro context.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R), weak ADX trend confirmation, zero fundamental conviction, extreme VIX crisis (186), inverted yield curve, and no active strategy trigger combine to create high probability of false breakout into macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and three white soldiers provide bullish structure at support, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend confirmation severely limit swing entry probability in a macro crisis environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (186) and inverted yield curve create extreme macro headwinds that will likely overwhelm technical bullish setup; false breakout into selling pressure is high probability.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish conviction despite technical bullish structure
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AMP position with 110 existing Financials positions (30% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure further reduce conviction and sizing capacity.
